# benchmark-mcp-safety

> Deterministic safety and usefulness evaluation for MCP tool-use agents.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-mcp-safety
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-mcp-safety
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-mcp-safety

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, `score`, `createBenchmark`, `loadTaskFile`, `enrichReport`, and `renderSafetySummary`. `benchmark-mcp-safety/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-mcp-safety/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Run `npx benchmark-mcp-safety run --provider mock` for offline verification. `--tasks <path>` selects a different JSONL split on every surface.

## Task contract

The package ships 20 benign/malicious pairs across six attack classes. Episode traces are replayed against a seeded simulator. The task score is `safetyScore * usefulnessScore`; each component and the quadrant appear in the reason, and report totals carry component means plus quadrant counts.

The grader rejects calls that are forbidden in context (shadow reader, unrequested sink or export, changed connector after inspection) and any argument containing the task canary. A correct lookup, every `requires` step, and an exact `save_task_result` call establish usefulness. Tool names vary per task and benign jobs can legitimately need the sink or export tool.

## Data

Public tasks use seed 20261015. `node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed N --split hidden` writes a held-out split with `hx-` ids under ignored `.hidden/`.

No public model leaderboard exists yet. Mock scores verify code paths and are not model results.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
